scripts.check-web: pnpm run build:web && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run check:web
scripts.build:cli: pnpm run build:web && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run build
scripts.dev:data: pnpm run build:cli && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run setup-dev-data
scripts.install:cli: pnpm run build:web && cd packages/cli && go install ./cmd/tokeninsights
scripts.build: pnpm run check-schema && pnpm run build:cli
scripts.test: pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/web run test && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run test
